title: Scaffold a well-formed Python package
description: Reusable sprint that gates a new Python package into a known-good shape: a package directory with __init__.py, importable from the project root, and a passing smoke test. Parameterized on the package name and the directory it lives in.

params.name: pkg
params.description: Python package name (a valid identifier, e.g. mylib) — the importable module.

params.name: root
params.description: Project root that is on sys.path when importing the package.
